column1: # ScreenScraper's 'wor' entry wins the region chain, and sometimes it holds
# junk: a sequel's title, a ROM hack's title, a Chinese release, or the name
# truncated to its first word. The game is identified correctly and gets the
# right box; only the printed name in gameinfo.tsv is wrong, and nothing else
# in the pipeline can fix it.
# Found with name_audit.py. Every line here was checked against the other
# names in the same fiche with inspect_meta.py -- a low similarity alone is
# not evidence, and most of what that script flags is a legitimate retitle.
